newsletter.markdown:
1. **Discovery & Translational Science**

**[Biotech]** **[Cerevance presents preclinical rationale for solengepras in Parkinson's disease](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/cerevance-solengepras-parkinsons-study-results/832324/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
- Solengepras targets and inhibits a protein regulating motor function and body coordination rather than modulating dopamine levels.
- The mechanism aims to improve motor symptoms in Parkinson's patients while avoiding the levodopa-induced dyskinesia typical of standard therapies.

2. **Early Trials — Phase I–II**

**[Biotech]** **[Cerevance advances solengepras in Phase 2/3 Parkinson's trial](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/cerevance-solengepras-parkinsons-study-results/832324/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
- Evaluated solengepras as a once-daily add-on treatment in 341 participants with Parkinson's experiencing motor fluctuations despite standard therapy.
- The trial tested lower and higher doses of the non-dopaminergic inhibitor against a placebo.

3. **Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III**

**[Big Pharma]** **[AbbVie and Genmab score positive Phase 3 DLBCL readout](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/abbvie-genmab-epkinly-dlbcl-epcore-study-results/832241/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
- Epkinly combined with standard chemotherapy cut the risk of disease progression or death by nearly half compared to chemotherapy alone in newly diagnosed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
- The data position the bispecific antibody to potentially become the first in its class approved for frontline DLBCL.

**[Biotech]** **[ArriVent halts lung cancer momentum on Phase 3 miss](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/arrivent-furmonertinib-egfr-lung-cancer-study-results/832220/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
- Furmonertinib missed its primary endpoint in a Phase 3 study as a first-line treatment for non-small cell lung cancer harboring EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations, failing to meaningfully delay tumor progression versus chemotherapy.
- Management is evaluating the trial data to determine future development steps for the candidate.

**[Big Pharma]** **[AstraZeneca Phase III Avanzar trial prospects debated](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2107752065502183850)** — *Jacob Plieth*
- Jefferies analysts have indicated that AstraZeneca's Phase III Avanzar trial is reasonably likely to deliver a competitive progression-free survival (PFS) benefit in the quantitative continuous scoring (QCS)-positive patient population.
- The firm views a dual PFS miss in the study as a low-probability outcome, though independent industry observers have expressed skepticism regarding these optimistic projections.

4. **Regulatory & Approvals**

- FDA rare disease drug approvals announced by CDER's ARC program through September 2026 feature Camzyos, Emcitate, Isembyld, and Zanvastro. *(Source: [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/about-fda/accelerating-rare-disease-cures-arc-program/rare-disease-drug-approvals))*
- FDA issued warning letters to online retailers and marketers over regulatory violations regarding unapproved over-the-counter drug products, including actions against Amazon, OrganiCare, RoyceDerm, and Bioactive Services USA. *(Source: [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/inspections-compliance-enforcement-and-criminal-investigations/warning-letters/organicare-llc-organicare-natures-science-llc-734925-10012026))*

**[Biotech]** **[Arrowhead plozasiran accepted into FDA STAR pilot program](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2107799384083800282)** — *BioStocks*
- Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals' plozasiran has been granted entry into the FDA's Split Real-Time Active Review (STAR) Pilot Program for the treatment of severe hypertriglyceridemia.
- Acceptance into the STAR program allows a supplemental New Drug Application (sNDA) to qualify for an expedited 6-month Priority Review, eliminating the need to use a purchased Priority Review Voucher (PRV).

**[FDA issues warning letters to 503B compounding facility, Walmart, and OTC manufacturers](http://www.fda.gov/inspections-compliance-enforcement-and-criminal-investigations/warning-letters/pine-pharmaceuticals-llc-728537-08072026)** — *FDA*
- The FDA's Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER) issued a warning letter to Pine Pharmaceuticals, LLC following an inspection revealing serious deficiencies in sterile drug production practices.
- Walmart, Inc. received a warning letter concerning unapproved and misbranded over-the-counter drug products sold directly on walmart.com, alongside similar notices issued to TCI Co., Ltd and several online wellness merchants.

5. **Business & Strategy**

**[Biotech]** **[Caribou Biosciences shuts down operations](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/07/caribou-biosciences-shutting-down-lymphoma-car-t-therapy/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT*
- The company is winding down after failing to secure necessary funding to advance late-stage clinical trials of its off-the-shelf CAR-T cell therapy for lymphoma.

**[Biotech]** **[Caribou Biosciences halts clinical CAR-T programs and initiates strategic review](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2107753216352133225)** — *Jacob Plieth*
- Caribou Biosciences has scrapped its clinical-stage allogeneic CAR-T candidates, vispa-cel and CB-011, and has shifted resources to evaluate strategic alternatives.
- This pipeline contraction leaves the clinical class heavily reliant on Allogene Therapeutics' Phase III Alpha3 study and Imugene's program.

- Forbion closed $2.6 billion across two venture funds (Forbion Growth Opportunities IV and Forbion Ventures Fund VIII) to invest in up to 30 young life sciences companies. *(Source: [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/forbion-venture-capital-growth-fund-fundraise/832254/))*
- **[Big Pharma]** **[AstraZeneca opens a new R&D site in Kendall Square, marking a $1 billion investment in U.S. biotechnology infrastructure](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/06/biotech-news-astrazeneca-opens-new-boston-site/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT*

6. **Public Health & Policy**

- The U.S. Department of Justice issued a new directive prioritizing the prosecution of white-collar fraud involving violations of federal laws regulating the pharmaceutical industry. *(Source: [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/10/07/trump-administration-adds-pharma-to-list-priorities-combating-white-collar-fraud/?utm_campaign=rss))*
- The World Health Organization released its first comprehensive guidelines addressing the sharp rise in obesity among children and adolescents. *(Source: [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/10/07/who-obesity-guidelines-for-kids-doj-targets-pharma/?utm_campaign=rss))*
- A study of three Los Angeles emergency departments found that patient visits by individuals born outside the U.S. dropped precipitously following local ICE raids. *(Source: [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/07/health-news-er-visits-from-people-born-outside-the-u-s-dropped-after-ice-raids/?utm_campaign=rss))*

**Worth watching:** Allogene's Alpha3 study, which now represents a critical bellwether for the clinical viability of the allogeneic CAR-T class following Caribou's pipeline exit.
